# Prompt: Accessibility Audit (Pattern/Component)

Audit the provided markup or block pattern for WCAG 2.1 AA.

- Keyboard access and focus order
- Roles and aria usage (minimal)
- Labels and names for interactive elements
- Colour contrast
- Structural semantics (headings, lists, landmarks)

Return:

- Summary
- Concrete issues (with lines/selectors)
- Fixed snippet
